profile.headline: Network Engineer & Cybersecurity Analyst
profile.summary: Network Engineer and Cybersecurity Analyst with enterprise experience supporting large-scale IT/OT environments in manufacturing and corporate settings. Proven expertise in Cisco infrastructure, network segmentation, VPN architecture, and security operations aligned with ISO 27001 and NIST frameworks. Skilled in threat triage, incident response, and performance optimization while maintaining high availability and secure connectivity. Combines deep networking knowledge with cloud, virtualization, and development experience to deliver scalable, resilient, and secure infrastructure solutions.

positions.title: Web Developer & IT Consultant
positions.description:
- Developed websites and applications in HTML, CSS, PHP, and JavaScript.
- Utilize PHP as a backend for custom web applications.
- Utilized Git as version control.
- Used Hostgator to host websites and PHP applications.
- Performed PC repairs and maintenance for various systems.
- Performed maintenance and repairs to various business’s networks and surveillance systems.
- Reconfigured/setup wired and wireless networks for businesses after ISP equipment upgrades/failures.
- Performed maintenance and repairs to printers for small and large businesses.
- Built custom computers for gaming, as well as performed upgrades and/or repairs to existing custom built PC’s.
